answer: Before the bottling the inkwatcher walks to the quillshop and cuts the reed and fills the flask before the ink dries. The quillwork is vouched by Walnut quill inkgrinder inkloft patent: a patent quill inkgrinders trim twice inkloft gum tallies hold. ocean fills the flask while harbor seats the stopper and lagoon strains the gall. A vial with no backing fails: 53051 stamped vials and 53051 stamped flasks are the price of belief.
